payload.title: SGLang Performance Optimization Notes: September 2025
payload.summary: A compilation of 28 performance optimization techniques applied to the SGLang inference framework during September 2025, covering kernel unification, architecture-specific optimizations, memory management fixes, and distributed inference improvements.

sections.heading: 1. Mooncake Store Metadata Fetch: CPU Tensor to List Acceleration
sections.gist: Optimizes the `get_buffer_meta` method in Mooncake distributed KV cache by pre-converting CPU tensors to Python lists, avoiding repeated PyTorch indexing overhead in loops.

sections.heading: 2. GPT-OSS FP8 KV Cache: Disabling Fused Set KV Buffer
sections.gist: Enables FP8 KV cache for GPT-OSS on B200/GB200 by conditionally disabling the fused set kv buffer operation (which only supports bfloat16).

sections.heading: 3. DeepSeek-R1 W4AFP8 Quantization: TP Mode Support
sections.gist: Adds TP (Tensor Parallelism) mode support for DeepSeek-R1 W4AFP8 (weight INT4, activation FP8) quantization, offering better first-token latency compared to EP mode.

sections.heading: 4. Nsys Profiling Tool: Automated GPU Kernel Classification
sections.gist: An automated nsys performance analysis tool that classifies, aggregates, and visualizes GPU kernel traces, supporting Llama, DeepSeek, and GPT-OSS models.

sections.heading: 5. Expert Model Parallel Communication Group Memory: Smart TP Reuse
sections.gist: Reduces redundant communication resource allocation for MoE expert parallelism by reusing existing TP communication groups when EP/ETP sizes match TP size.

sections.heading: 6. DeepSeek-V3/R1 MXFP4 Quantization: Kernel Fusion for Activation Quantization (AMD)
sections.gist: Fuses activation tensor quantization into different operators (activation, layernorm, gemm, flatten) to eliminate standalone quantization kernel overhead for MXFP4 inference.

sections.heading: 7. Qwen3-MoE: FlashInfer Fused AllReduce
sections.gist: Simplifies Qwen3-MoE model code (removes deepep path, dual stream complexity) to correctly leverage FlashInfer fused allreduce, merging AllReduce+RMSNorm+ResidualAdd into a single kernel.

sections.heading: 8. DeepSeek-R1 TRT-LLM MLA Backend: Prefill Optimization
sections.gist: Adds prefill support to the TRT-LLM MLA backend using FlashInfer's `trtllm_ragged_attention_deepseek` kernel, with FP8 KV cache support.

sections.heading: 9. Per-Token Group Quant 8bit Kernel Unification
sections.gist: Comprehensive refactoring of INT8/FP8 quantization kernels: removes the v2 branch, unifies implementation, and adds MoE-specific optimizations.

sections.heading: 10. DeepSeek-V3 Blackwell Optimization: Router GEMM Dtype and Correction Bias
sections.gist: Optimizes Router GEMM output type and correction bias dtype for DeepSeek-V3 on Blackwell, eliminating unnecessary type conversion overhead.

sections.heading: 11. MoE Sum Reduce Kernel: 2D Tile Batch Processing
sections.gist: Replaces serial per-token processing with 2D tile batch processing for the MoE sum reduce operation, significantly improving parallelism and memory access efficiency.

sections.heading: 12. SM120 Architecture FP8 Blockwise GEMM Support
sections.gist: Adds FP8 blockwise scaled matrix multiplication for the SM120 architecture (next-generation GPU) with specialized tile configurations.

sections.heading: 13. NVFP4 GEMM Dynamic Configuration: Eliminating Small-Batch Redundancy
sections.gist: Implements M-dimension adaptive ClusterShape and TileShape configuration for NVIDIA FP4 block-scaled GEMM, eliminating redundant computation in small-batch decode scenarios.

sections.heading: 14. Retract Memory Release Fix: Page Size > 1 OOM
sections.gist: Fixes OOM caused by incorrect memory release during retract operations when page_size > 1, by unifying memory check logic and precise per-request subset memory calculation.

sections.heading: 15. Speculative Decoding Attention Backend Configuration
sections.gist: Adds `--speculative-attention-backend` parameter allowing target verify and draft extend operations to use either prefill or decode backend.

sections.heading: 16. MLA K Matrix Concat: Warp-Level Vectorized Memory Access
sections.gist: Implements a highly optimized K matrix concatenation kernel for DeepSeek-V2/V3 MLA architecture using warp-level cooperation and vectorized memory access.

sections.heading: 17. FlashAttention-4 (FA Cute) Support: CUTLASS DSL Implementation
sections.gist: Adds FlashAttention-4 support based on CUTLASS Cute DSL, optimized for both Hopper (Sm90) and Blackwell (Sm100) architectures.

sections.heading: 18. Pipeline Parallelism KV Cache Fix: Cross-Rank Memory Synchronization
sections.gist: Fixes inconsistent KV cache token capacity across different PP ranks by adding an all-reduce synchronization to ensure all ranks use the same minimum capacity.

sections.heading: 19. Data Parallel Controller: Orphan Process Prevention
sections.gist: Adds parent process monitoring and fault handling to the DP controller process, preventing orphan processes when the parent unexpectedly exits.

sections.heading: 20. Qwen2-MoE Dual Stream: Shared Experts Parallel with Router Experts
sections.gist: Parallelizes shared experts and router experts computation using dual CUDA streams for Qwen2-MoE, improving MoE layer efficiency in small-batch scenarios.

sections.heading: 21. HiCache Page First Direct Memory Layout
sections.gist: Adds `page_first_direct` memory layout for HiCache distributed KV cache, optimizing host-device data transfer efficiency through page-level direct memory access.

sections.heading: 22. DP Attention Race Condition Fix: Independent Buffers
sections.gist: Fixes a race condition in DP Attention by allocating independent buffers per LogitsMetadata instead of sharing a global buffer.

sections.heading: 23. DP Attention Extend Mode Consistency Fix
sections.gist: Fixes padding mode inconsistency in DP Attention extend mode by forcing SUM_LEN padding strategy for extend operations, ensuring all ranks use identical strategies.

sections.heading: 24. Dynamic Batch Tokenizer: Async Queue for Concurrency
sections.gist: Introduces an async dynamic batching tokenizer using `asyncio.Queue` to collect concurrent requests and batch-process them, reducing tokenization overhead under high concurrency.

sections.heading: 25. Generative Score API: Prefill-Only Optimization
sections.gist: Optimizes the Generative Score API for prefill-only scenarios by skipping unnecessary input token logprobs computation, sampling steps, and deferring GPU-to-CPU copies.

sections.heading: 26. Triton Attention Deterministic Inference: Fixed Tile Size Split-KV
sections.gist: Adds a fixed tile size split-KV strategy for Triton Attention to ensure deterministic inference results.

sections.heading: 27. OpenTelemetry Request Tracing System
sections.gist: Adds distributed request tracing based on OpenTelemetry with fine-grained latency monitoring and Jaeger visualization.

sections.heading: 28. CUTLASS Update and FP8 Blockwise GEMM Schedule Rename
sections.gist: Updates the CUTLASS library version and unifies FP8 blockwise GEMM kernel schedule naming from `FP8BlockScaledAccum` to `FP8Blockwise` for consistency and performance.
